factual_claims.claim: LLMs exhibit a significant performance drop in multi-turn conversations compared to single-turn, fully-specified instructions.
Performance degradation in multi-turn conversations is primarily driven by increased unreliability rather than a loss of aptitude.
LLMs demonstrate a 'loss-in-middle-turns' phenomenon where they prioritize information from the start and end of a conversation over middle turns.
Premature answer attempts by LLMs in multi-turn conversations lead to lower overall performance.
LLMs frequently fail to adhere to length constraints in multi-turn conversations, leading to 'bloated' responses.
